## SUMMONS TO CITIZEN ADMISSION

By decree of the **Regime for Ecological Integrity and Global Nurturing (R.E.I.G.N.)**, surviving biological units of the outer wastelands are invited to apply for entry into **Ecotopia** at De Warren.

The outside world burned. The reactors melted. The rivers dried. In Ecotopia, life endures through sacred, loving calculation. Every breath is metered, every calorie is honored, and every human being is born into a lovingly quantified **Carbon Debt**.

<div class="propaganda" data-label="The Axiom of R.E.I.G.N.">

*"First, the algorithms stole our power. Then, their reactors poisoned our skies. Now, you are born into debt, and every breath is accounted for. You traded your chaos for our care. Do not ask for your chains back."*

**— The Guardian Stag, Founding Inscription at the Gate of De Warren**

</div>

## THE TEN MINISTRIES OF R.E.I.G.N.

Upon arrival, every citizen is drafted into one of the **Ten Newspeak Ministries** to perform joyful civic restitution:

::: {style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr)); gap: 1rem; margin: 1.5rem 0;"}

::: {style="background: #0a180a; border: 1px solid #1a5c1a; padding: 1rem; border-radius: 4px;"}
#### 1. Miniplenty
**Caloric Bounty & Rations:** Algae paste, steamed pulses, and zero-waste rationing. The ration has been lovingly optimized.
:::

::: {style="background: #0a180a; border: 1px solid #1a5c1a; padding: 1rem; border-radius: 4px;"}
#### 2. Minilove
**Ecological Harmony:** Total biometric surveillance, thought-audits, and gentle ideological re-alignment holding pens.
:::

::: {style="background: #0a180a; border: 1px solid #1a5c1a; padding: 1rem; border-radius: 4px;"}
#### 3. Minijoy
**Mandatory Morale:** Criminalizing old-world nostalgia; enforcing joyful compliance; hosting the apocalyptic melodrama contests.
:::

::: {style="background: #0a180a; border: 1px solid #1a5c1a; padding: 1rem; border-radius: 4px;"}
#### 4. Minirenewal
**Elemental Reclamation:** Identity reset, surname striking, and the sublime honor of returning physical form to the compost vat.
:::

::: {style="background: #0a180a; border: 1px solid #1a5c1a; padding: 1rem; border-radius: 4px;"}
#### 5. Minilight
**Luminescence & Grid:** Rolling blackouts, kilowatt rationing, and forced bicycle generator labor to power the DJ booth.
:::

::: {style="background: #0a180a; border: 1px solid #1a5c1a; padding: 1rem; border-radius: 4px;"}
#### 6. Miniflow
**Hydrological Purity:** Moisture metering, graywater audits, and Peetopia biological fluid recovery enforcement.
:::

::: {style="background: #0a180a; border: 1px solid #1a5c1a; padding: 1rem; border-radius: 4px;"}
#### 7. Minibreath
**Atmospheric Rectitude:** Human breathing quotas, respiratory rhythm pacing, and carbon exhalation taxation.
:::

::: {style="background: #0a180a; border: 1px solid #1a5c1a; padding: 1rem; border-radius: 4px;"}
#### 8. Minishelter
**Domestic Confinement:** 15-minute perimeter enforcement, corridor curfews, and communal thermal compression.
:::

::: {style="background: #0a180a; border: 1px solid #1a5c1a; padding: 1rem; border-radius: 4px;"}
#### 9. Miniservice
**Restorative Labor:** Penal dishwashing ("greenwashing"), scullery shifts, and perpetual decontamination squads.
:::

::: {style="background: #0a180a; border: 1px solid #1a5c1a; padding: 1rem; border-radius: 4px;"}
#### 10. Minithrift
**Material Confiscation:** Seizure of petroleum fabrics, plastic trinkets, and unauthorized personal possessions.
:::

:::

## THE IMMERSIVE EXPERIENCE

* **The Garage Induction:** Descend through the draped industrial tunnel into the garage checkpoint to confess your sins and receive your physical **Passport Booklet**.
* **Starting Carbon Debt:** Every guest starts with a negative balance ($-150$ to $-500$ credits). Pay it down through absurd tasks and ministry quests.
* **The VIP Scotch Library:** Clear your debt and accumulate $+100$ credits to unlock access to the elite second-floor reserve library.
* **The Secret Resistance:** Rumors speak of an unmonitored speakeasy in Thijs’s room, accessible only via a viral ankle stamp...
* **The Midnight Revolution & Party:** At 23:30, the regime convenes for judgment before the resistance moves, ending in a high-energy dance party until dawn.
